# Paris to Barcelona Budget Trip Plan

A family-friendly 4-day plan for **2 adults + 1 child (8)**, optimized for **low total cost**, **easy airport timing**, and **walking under 8 km/day**.
I’m assuming you want the **cheapest practical flight times**, a **central but not luxury hotel area**, and **one room** for all 3 travelers.

## Recommended Booking Plan

| Item | Recommendation | Why it fits | Estimated cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Flight timing | **Out: Fri 2026-04-10, early morning**; **Return: Mon 2026-04-13, late afternoon/evening** | Usually the best value while preserving most of each day | **€300–€520 total** |
| Flight type | **Non-stop, low-cost carrier** | Lowest fare and simplest with a child | Included above |
| Hotel area | **Eixample or Poblenou** | Good transit, safer/easier walking, better budget balance than Gothic Quarter | — |
| Room type | **1 family room or 1 triple room** | Avoids booking 2 rooms; best value for 3 people | **€420–€720 for 3 nights** |
| Local transport | **Metro + occasional taxi** | Keeps walking low and costs controlled | **€40–€80** |
| Food budget | **Mix of breakfast included + casual lunches/dinners** | Budget-friendly without overplanning | **€210–€330** |
| Attractions | **Mostly free/low-cost sights** | Best for family budget | **€40–€100** |

## Budget-Friendly Trip Breakdown

| Category | Low estimate | Higher estimate |
|---|---|---|
| Flights for 3 | €300 | €520 |
| Hotel, 3 nights | €420 | €720 |
| Local transport | €40 | €80 |
| Food | €210 | €330 |
| Attractions | €40 | €100 |
| **Estimated total** | **€1,010** | **€1,750** |

### Best-value booking choice
- **Flight:** choose the **earliest outbound** and **latest reasonable return** to maximize your stay.
- **Hotel:** book **Eixample** first if you want the best balance of price, transit, and comfort.
- **Room:** prioritize a **triple room with breakfast** or **family room** if the price difference is small.

## 4-Day Family Itinerary

### Day 1: Arrival + Easy Center Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning:** Fly from Paris to Barcelona; take metro or airport transfer to hotel.
- **Afternoon:** Light stroll around **Plaça de Catalunya** and **Passeig de Gràcia**; keep walking to about **4–6 km**.
- **Food:** Simple tapas or pizza near the hotel to avoid a long first-day outing.
- **Action:** [Button: Map route](https://www.google.com/maps)

### Day 2: Gaudí Highlights Without Overwalking
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Visit **Sagrada Família** area first; book timed entry if you plan to go inside.
- **Afternoon:** Move by metro or short taxi to **Passeig de Gràcia** for **Casa Batlló** or exterior views only.
- **Food:** Casual lunch near Eixample; keep the day compact.
- **Walking target:** **5–7 km**
- **Action:** [Button: Transit plan](https://www.tmb.cat/en/barcelona)

### Day 3: Beachfront + Park Time
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Morning:** Head to **Barceloneta beach** for a relaxed start.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/a/aa/Beach%2C_Barcelona_%28P1170715%29.jpg Alt=Morning:** Head to **Barceloneta beach** for a relaxed start, Barcelona, Spain
- **Afternoon:** Visit **Ciutadella Park** and nearby promenade; use metro between areas to keep steps low.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/04/Barcelona_-_Parc_de_la_Ciutadella_%281%29.jpg Alt=Afternoon:** Visit **Ciutadella Park** and nearby promenade; use metro between areas to keep steps low, Barcelona, Spain
- **Food:** Sandwiches, bakery lunch, or a relaxed seafood meal if budget allows.
- **Walking target:** **4–7 km**
- **Action:** [Button: Family outing ideas](https://www.barcelona.cat/en/what-to-do-in-bcn)

### Day 4: Short Morning + Departure
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- **Morning:** Quick breakfast, last walk near the hotel, and souvenir stop if needed.
- **Afternoon:** Check out and head to the airport with extra time for family travel.
- **Food:** Airport lunch or an early meal near the station/airport.
- **Walking target:** **Under 4 km**
- **Action:** [Button: Airport transport](https://www.aena.es/en/josep-tarradellas-barcelona-el-prat.html)
